steps.tx: Acute bilateral **urinary tract obstruction** triggers a **triphasic hemodynamic** response: an initial transient rise in blood flow and pressure during the first **1** to **2** hours, followed by renal **vasoconstriction** up to **24** hours, and persistent vasoconstriction thereafter. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

steps.tx: **Renal ultrasound** is the primary diagnostic imaging modality for evaluating obstructive uropathy, but false-negative examinations lacking **hydronephrosis** occur in early obstruction under **24** to **48** hours, profound volume depletion, or encasement by **retroperitoneal fibrosis**. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

left.title: Classic Ultrasound Findings
points: Calyceal dilation: Moderate to severe hydronephrosis
Parenchyma: Increased cortical echogenicity in chronic cases
Ureteral jets: Absent or asymmetrical on color Doppler
Bladder status: Distended post-void residual volume

right.title: False-Negative Pitfalls
points: Hyperacute obstruction: Onset under 24 to 48 hours
Volume depletion: Severe dehydration masking calyceal stretch
External encasement: Retroperitoneal fibrosis freezing ureters
Confirmatory test: Non-contrast CT or antegrade pyelography

steps.tx: **Post-obstructive diuresis**, or **POD**, is defined as profound **urine output** exceeding **200** mL/h for at least **2** consecutive hours or greater than **3** to **4** liters daily following surgical relief of severe bilateral urinary obstruction. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.
steps.say: Post-obstructive diuresis, or POD, is defined as profound urine output exceeding 200 mL/h for at least 2 consecutive hours or greater than 3 to 4 liters daily following surgical relief of severe bilateral urinary obstruction. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

rows: Excretion of accumulated retained water and urea solutes
Impaired tubular reabsorption and medullary gradient washout

steps.tx: **Pathologic post-obstructive diuresis** features inappropriate tubular sodium wasting and water loss driven by **medullary washout**, downregulation of collecting duct **aquaporins** including AQP2 and AQP3, impaired **NKCC2** cotransport, and complete resistance to vasopressin. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

steps.tx: Clinical management of **post-obstructive diuresis** mandates structured **electrolyte replacement** using **0.45%** **saline** with added potassium, replacing approximately **50%** to **75%** of hourly urinary losses to avoid perpetuating iatrogenic volume expansion. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

left.title: Recommended Protocol
points: Replacement fraction: 50% to 75% of preceding hour urine volume
Potassium repletion: Supplemental potassium chloride added to fluids
Goal: Gradual autologous tapering of polyuric response

right.title: Hazardous Practices
points: Excessive replacement: Replacing 100% of hourly urine output
Inappropriate fluid: Large volumes of 0.9% normal saline
Consequence: Perpetuation of volume overload diuresis
Electrolyte risk: Severe hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia

steps.tx: **Retroperitoneal fibrosis**, known as **Ormond disease**, causes **medial deviation** of the middle third of both ureters with extrinsic hydronephrosis. It is idiopathic in two-thirds of cases, frequently representing an active manifestation of systemic **IgG4-related** disease. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

steps.tx: Chronic unrelieved obstruction triggers **tubulointerstitial fibrosis**, tubular epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and progressive upregulation of **TGF-beta**, leading to irreversible nephron destruction and established chronic **obstructive nephropathy**. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients. Structured clinical management and regular follow-up help guide therapeutic optimization and prevent disease complications.

steps.tx: Electrolyte disturbances in chronic obstruction classically manifest as a hyperkalemic normal anion gap metabolic acidosis consistent with a **Type 4 RTA** phenotype, resulting from distal collecting duct **aldosterone resistance** and impaired proton secretion in **obstructive uropathy**. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.
